get.summary: Get full trace detail by tag

hashtag.description: tag name without # prefix; non-nil only for hashtag channels

isHashtag.description: true if key was derived from a hashtag PSK

keyKnown.description: true if Beacon has a decryption key for this channel

lastSeen.description: epoch ms, time of most recent message

name.description: display name from config or nil

observationCount.description: number of packet_observations rows for this message's packet hash

packetHash.description: hex-encoded packet hash for correlation with packet events

senderName.description: display name from the decrypted payload

sentAt.description: epoch ms, from the sender's embedded timestamp

isHashtag.description: true if key was derived from a hashtag PSK

keyKnown.description: true if Beacon has a decryption key for this channel

lastSeen.description: epoch ms, time of most recent message

name.description: display name from config or nil

iatas.description: IATAs this node has been heard in

hour.description: epoch ms, start of the 1-hour bucket

hashSize.description: per-hop hash size in bytes (1, 2, or 3)

count.description: number of observers or nodes on this preset in this IATA

snr.description: signal-to-noise ratio in dB, if available

nodes.description: empty for "none", one for "high", multiple for "ambiguous"

node.description: populated when node details are available

nodeCount.description: distinct nodes with this as their default scope

observerCount.description: distinct observers that forwarded packets in this scope

packetCount.description: distinct packets matched to this scope

floodAdvertCount.description:
FloodAdvertCount/DirectAdvertCount split AdvertCount by how the advert was routed:
flood = route type 0 (transport_flood) or 1 (flood), broadcast with no known path;
direct = route type 2 (direct) or 3 (transport_direct), routed along a known path.
FloodAdvertCount + DirectAdvertCount == AdvertCount.

packets.description: all packets observed for this trace

rawPath.description: hops as received in the packet

iataCount.description: number of distinct IATAs where heard

packetCount.description: number of packets with this trace tag

pathHashes.description: hops from the most complete observation

snrValues.description: SNR per hop from the most complete observation

tags.description: Airport/location codes that group observers and packets
